title: Could be much better
body: I appreciate the effort, but it is a very very basic app. It only allowed us to chose three habits. I understand the teachings of the book (I loved the book!), but only three is so few. It forces me to have a second app to keep track of other habits and my to do lists….
author: Blablablabla!!……..

title: Finally
body: I was waiting for this app for a long time! Simple to use and really helpful! I love it!
author: MrBike69
